ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white) pixels, approximately 95:5 distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous field across both lobes; localized high-contrast circular rings on the left lobe mid-section; parallel linear high-contrast streaks on the right lobe medial-upper section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 105 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge boundary; extreme structural irregularities at distal tips due to high-intensity encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from distal tips towards the median notch along the trailing boundary; distal edges show irregular convex curves.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately six circular white-on-black rings clustered in the lower-central region of the left lobe and two isolated rings on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel high-contrast linear marks on the right lobe's upper quadrant, consistent with rake mark scarring patterns; minor short linear disruptions near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacle clusters) on both fluke tips causing significant topographical deviation and pixel density changes; prominent rake mark scars on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-density pixel clusters at the furthest lateral extent of both lobes representing heavy acorn barnacle colonization.
